_doc: The aqua skin's toolbar art: every glyph the line-art table names, glossy and in colour on a 32 grid (lit from above, a gel or brushed-metal body, a dark rim). Each entry is the inner markup of one <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32">, carrying only the gradients it paints with; `%u` in a gradient id is a per-instance token the painter replaces, so many copies on one page never share an id. Installed by browser js/ui/aqua/icons.js, the desktop's support/aqua/icons.cpp and the extension's lib/aqua/skin.js.
